items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: And Chano and I became roommates and he loved the band so, you know, and he was a showman.

ctx.x: So did you stay there in Detroit for a while?

A week. And then we went on the road. For that week, Ella was the star and she'd caught ahold of bop and she was scattin' and she was pickin' up and everything. It was a good week. Chano Pozo was with him; that's when I first saw Chano.
He was already with Dizzy when you joined the band?
